description: One priced component line of a Rate Card. Carries its own day-rate basis (C3, per line) and its seeded money value; the value is withheld from the committed structure and populated only by the out-of-repo seeding step.

fields.description: Which billing component this line prices.
fields.label: Component
fields.options:
day_rate
ot_rate
gosi_fee
charge_fee
levy
eos_basis
basic
allowances

fields.description: C3 per-line day-rate basis: how the package value converts to a day rate for THIS line. explicit_rate_per_day means rc_value is already the day rate. Required on a day-rate line of a package-day / attendance-day card; there is no flat divisor default.
fields.label: Day Rate Basis

fields.description: The unit rc_value is expressed in.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: The rate / fee value for this line. WITHHELD from the committed structure - seeded out-of-repo. No default: a zero here would silently misprice.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: Stock ERPNext Service Item this line maps to, so the invoice generator reuses a stock Sales Invoice line.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Provenance - which billing-master column this line's value came from (e.g. Rate/Day, OT Rate/hr, GOSI). Structural, non-confidential.
fields.label: Source Field

name: Rate Card Component Row
